notes: The signature {0,1,+,-,.,<} with binary subtraction; instance of the registered signature macro.
Ordered-field axioms plus the polynomial intermediate-value scheme, in the ordered-ring signature; already printed in the P3 catalogue tables without a registry row.

role: sign function of an ordered field
notes: Maps a field element to -1, 0 or 1; applied coordinatewise to lists of polynomial values.

role: truncation and formal derivative of a parametric polynomial
notes: Both carry a formal degree as data; the formal leading coefficient may vanish.

role: root bound of a one-variable polynomial
notes: 1 plus the sum of the absolute ratios of lower coefficients to the leading coefficient; beyond it the polynomial has the sign of its leading term.

role: sign table of a polynomial list and its finite range
notes: A word of odd length over sign vectors listing cells in order; T_{s,D} is the set of words of length at most 2D+1 over vectors of length s.
Combinatorial function on words determined by an injective index selection; independent of the field.
The definite remainder produced by the recursion of the pseudo-division lemma; formal degree one less than that of Q.

role: quantifier-free formula defining a sign table
notes: Formula in the parameter variables only, valid uniformly in every real closed field.

role: real ordered field with a predicate for the integers
notes: Expansion of the real field by a unary predicate Z; neither o-minimal nor NIP.

role: trace of a set family on a finite set
notes: The family of intersections S with A for S in the family F; F shatters A when the trace is the whole power set of A.

role: set of subsets shattered by a family
notes: Used only inside the proof of the trace-counting lemma; subsets of a finite set A.
Product of the coordinates of the tuple x raised to the entries of the exponent vector alpha.

role: shattering bound for real closed fields
notes: Equal to 2^(d+1)(d+1)! where d is twice the total number of x-monomials of the polynomials after elimination.
